name: The Other Side of the Abyss
source:
In a vast machine-world, you and your AI suit must deliver a relic across the abyss. The path won't forgive mistakes.

[From [url=https://manupoons.itch.io/the-other-side-of-the-abyss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在广阔的机器世界中，你和你的人工智能套装必须跨越深渊运送一件文物。道路不会原谅错误。

[来自[url=https://manupoons.itch.io/the-other-side-of-the-abyss]Itch.io[/url]]
